formalObservation.Composition:
A large enclosing rectangular/rounded field contains several distinct figures and structural elements:

- tall elongated figure on the left
- large bird-like or animal-like figure centrally/right
- small triangular or wedge-shaped form at lower left
- vertically arranged chain of circular forms at upper right
- several horizontal and diagonal structural elements connecting the lower portion
formalObservation.Primary Forms:
- Tall elongated left figure
- Central/right animal-like figure
- Lower-left triangular form
- Vertical chain of circular units
- Large enclosing boundary
formalObservation.Visible Anatomical Features:
Left figure:

- Head-like upper form
- Eye-like marking
- Long vertical body
- Small lateral appendages
- Large oval lower form

Central/right figure:

- Head
- Single visible eye
- Beak-like projection
- Long neck
- Rounded body
- Four narrow lower extensions resembling legs/supports

Lower-left form:

- Eye-like circular marking
- Triangular enclosing contour
formalObservation.Structural Forms:
- Large enclosing border
- Horizontal upper structure
- Vertical connecting line
- Rounded/oval forms
- Horizontal lower platforms
- Diagonal ground elements
formalObservation.Repeated Forms:
- Circular units
- Oval forms
- Parallel hatching
- Vertical elements
- Horizontal bands
formalObservation.Mark-Making:
- parallel hatching
- thick charcoal contours
- dense dark passages
- repeated directional marks
- broad filled areas
- lighter linear construction
formalObservation.Figure–Ground Relationship: Strong but interconnected. Heavy surrounding hatching partially integrates figures into the larger field.
formalObservation.Formal Language:
- Large enclosing boundary.
- Strong vertical axis on the left.
- Large organic figure occupying central-right region.
- Repeated circular units introduced as a separate visual motif.
- Geometric and organic forms coexist.
- Dense hatching creates continuity across figures, structures and ground.
- Multiple directional axes create a more complex spatial arrangement.
